result.summary: The environment features a wide roadway with sidewalks on both sides, but lacks significant pedestrian protection. The excessive road width and lack of marked crossings or traffic calming measures likely encourage higher vehicle speeds and create long, unprotected crossing distances.

hazards.name: Wide Roadway
hazards.description: The excessive width of the asphalt encourages higher vehicle speeds and increases the time pedestrians are exposed to traffic while crossing.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions
hazards.description: The large food truck and parked vehicles on the left side of the street block sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and oncoming drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the intersection to shorten the crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add continental-style marked crosswalks to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the intersection to clear sightlines.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a continuous paved sidewalk, but it is significantly narrowed by a large utility pole placed directly in the walking path. There is no physical buffer or planting strip between the sidewalk and the adjacent parallel parking lane.

hazards.name: Sidewalk Obstruction
hazards.description: A large wooden utility pole is situated in the middle of the sidewalk, reducing the effective clear width for pedestrians and people using mobility devices.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: There is no separation or buffer zone between the sidewalk and the roadway/parking lane, increasing proximity to vehicles.
hazards.location_in_image: Edge of the sidewalk adjacent to the parked black SUV

interventions.title: Utility Pole Relocation
interventions.description: Relocate the utility pole to the edge of the sidewalk or underground to provide a clear, unobstructed walking path.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Buffer / Furniture Zone
interventions.description: Implement a furniture zone or planting strip between the sidewalk and the curb to provide physical and psychological separation from traffic.

result.summary: The intersection features marked zebra crosswalks and signal control, providing a basic level of pedestrian infrastructure. However, the environment lacks physical buffers between the sidewalk and the roadway, and the crossing distances are relatively wide without refuge islands.

hazards.name: Unprotected Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide intersection requires pedestrians to cross multiple lanes without a median or refuge island.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parking
hazards.description: Parked cars near the crosswalk can block the visibility of pedestrians to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the intersection near the crosswalk

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions (bulb-outs) to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between drivers and pedestrians.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Implement a signal phase that allows pedestrians to start crossing before vehicles get a green light to increase visibility.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is characterized by a wide, complex intersection with faded pavement markings and long crossing distances. While sidewalks exist in front of commercial buildings, the foreground features a disconnected path through a grassy island, and pedestrian-specific infrastructure like signals is not clearly visible.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide intersection requires pedestrians to cross a large expanse of asphalt, increasing exposure to traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground and mid-ground across the main roadway.

hazards.name: Faded Pavement Markings
hazards.description: Crosswalk and lane markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the intersection in the center of the image.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install continental-style crosswalk markings to improve visibility for approaching drivers.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Construct bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Countdown Signals
interventions.description: Install signals that show the remaining time to cross, improving safety and predictability.
